clue.text: Convert Alan into a citizen

indicators.note: to convert something is to change its form, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: the fodder, eight letters taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone named Alan is being naturalised as a citizen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Convert' tells you to rearrange ALANINTO; 'a' is a link before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A national is a person holding citizenship of a particular country, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Conscious of an area of disturbed air

parts.note: a wake is the trail of disturbed air or water left behind a moving craft

explanation.surface: Someone is sensitive to a patch of turbulent air.
explanation.definitionFit: Being conscious means being alert and not asleep, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Unknown cards held by one composer — fishy, his success

indicators.note: one thing held by another sits inside it, so the unknown and cards go within the other pieces

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
William Walton was an English composer
in algebra an unknown is often written Z
A, A, K: ace, ace and king, three playing cards

explanation.surface: A card player's hand is gripped by a musician, whose triumph seems suspicious.
explanation.walkthrough: ZAAK sits between I and WALTON. 'Fishy' is not suspicion: his success was a book about angling.
explanation.definitionFit: Izaak Walton won lasting fame with The Compleat Angler, a book about fishing, so his success was fishy.

clue.text: Put up some venom in a test tube

indicators.note: some of the following words is just a portion of them, so the answer lies within

explanation.surface: A laboratory scene: a sample of venom sits in a test tube.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'venom in a test'.
explanation.definitionFit: To put someone up for a post is to propose them as a candidate, a synonym.

clue.text: Leeds is cleaner after regeneration, host to new type of buttercup

indicators.note: a host has a guest inside, so the shuffled letters contain the next piece
regenerated letters are remade in a new arrangement, so these words are shuffled

parts.note: the fodder, fourteen letters taken as written

explanation.surface: Urban renewal has tidied the city of Leeds, which now harbours an unfamiliar wild flower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after regeneration' rearranges LEEDSISCLEANER, and 'host to' places N inside the result.
explanation.definitionFit: The lesser celandine is a small yellow spring flower of the buttercup family.

clue.text: Talk at length about one plagiarist

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the talking word goes round the numeral

parts.note: to prate is to talk on and on foolishly
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone rambles on about a single copier of others' work.
explanation.definitionFit: A pirate in publishing is one who reproduces others' work without permission, so a plagiarist.

clue.text: Promise assistant a part

parts.note: PA is short for personal assistant
a role is a part played by an actor

explanation.surface: A helper is promised a role in a production.
explanation.definitionFit: Parole is a word of honour, a prisoner's pledge given in exchange for release.

clue.text: Guy produces knitting pattern

definitions.meaning: to guy someone is to mock or tease them
a knitting stitch making raised vertical ridges

explanation.definitionFit: Rib means to tease, and it is also a ridged stitch pattern in knitting.

clue.text: Forbearance, as sleepy state is broken by enthusiastic shout

indicators.note: a word broken by another has the second inserted into it

parts.note: a trance is a dazed half-conscious state
ole is the cry of approval heard at a bullfight

explanation.surface: Patience gives way when a dozy mood is shattered by a loud cheer.
explanation.definitionFit: Tolerance is patient endurance of others, the same as forbearance.

clue.text: Salutation rejected by scholar, I'm sorry to say

indicators.note: rejected things are sent back, so the pieces are read in reverse

parts.note: MA, a Master of Arts, is a scholar
alas expresses regret, like I'm sorry to say

explanation.surface: A greeting is rebuffed by an academic, unfortunately.
explanation.definitionFit: A salaam is a low bow with the hand to the forehead, an Eastern greeting.

clue.text: Struggle with singular line penned by poet

parts.note: S is the grammatical abbreviation for singular

indicators.note: penned means enclosed, so the line goes inside the poet's name

parts.note: George Crabbe was an English poet

explanation.surface: Someone wrestles with a single verse line written by a poet.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrabble is to scrape or grope about frantically, so to struggle.

clue.text: Part of the year, a tiny piece

parts.note: wee is a Scottish word for tiny
K stands for king, a chess piece

explanation.surface: A small fragment of the calendar is described.
explanation.definitionFit: A week is seven days, one division of the calendar year.

clue.text: New World keen to get hold of English handicraft

indicators.note: getting hold of something means grasping it within, so a letter goes inside
new here means remade, so the following letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Americans are eager to acquire a traditional English craft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' looks like part of New World; it rearranges WORLDKEEN, which then holds E.
explanation.definitionFit: Needlework such as embroidery is a craft done by hand, a kind of handicraft.

clue.text: Obnoxious person has shoe left showing defects

parts.note: wart is slang for an unpleasant person
a sandal is an open shoe

explanation.surface: A nasty character has abandoned a shoe, revealing his faults.
explanation.definitionFit: Warts and all is an idiom for depicting something including its flaws.

clue.text: Boat's grotesque, old and huge

parts.note: a gig is a light ship's boat
antic is an archaic adjective meaning grotesque

explanation.surface: A vessel is weird, ancient and enormous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'old' says the sense of antic is archaic; 's is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Gigantic means of giant size, a synonym for huge.

clue.text: Son (or heir) goes bonkers (or loco)

indicators.note: going bonkers means going mad, so these letters are scrambled

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A son, or heir, loses his mind, or goes crazy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loco' looks like a slang synonym of bonkers; it is short for locomotive.
explanation.definitionFit: Iron horse is an old nickname for a railway locomotive, and loco is its abbreviation.

clue.text: By the sound of it, broke step

indicators.note: this signals that a word is to be heard, not spelt

parts.note: wrung, as of a neck twisted till it breaks

explanation.surface: Something appeared to snap a stair.
explanation.definitionFit: A rung is a step on a ladder.

clue.text: Brought up in large town, Turner is breaking down

indicators.note: in a down clue brought up means read from bottom to top, so the pieces run backwards

parts.note: a city is a large town
Lana Turner was a Hollywood film star

explanation.surface: A painter is reared in a city and then suffers a collapse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turner' suggests the painter; it is the actress Lana Turner. CITY + LANA reversed gives ANALYTIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Analytic describes analysis, the process of breaking a thing down into its parts.

clue.text: He entertains heartless composer

indicators.note: heartless means without the centre, so the middle letter goes

parts.note: Gustav Holst was the English composer of The Planets

explanation.surface: A party-giver entertains a cold-hearted composer.
explanation.definitionFit: A host is a person who receives and entertains guests.

clue.text: Telephone company employees keep in touch with flags

definitions.meaning: workers who put up and repair telephone wires
football officials who use flags to signal when the ball has gone over the touchline

explanation.definitionFit: Linesmen repair phone lines, and assistant referees run the touchline with flags.

clue.text: The meaning of introduce

definitions.meaning: the significance or sense of something
to bring goods or ideas in from elsewhere

explanation.definitionFit: Import as a noun is significance; as a verb it means to bring in.

clue.text: Extraordinary help one man is determined to give

indicators.note: determined is read as settled anew, so the letters are given a fresh order

parts.note: the fodder, ten letters taken as written

explanation.surface: A man resolves to offer help.
explanation.definitionFit: Phenomenal means remarkable or exceptional, so extraordinary.

clue.text: In which one receives reprimand for impudence

definitions.meaning: the body part where one gets it, as in the idiom about a scolding

explanation.definitionFit: To get it in the neck is to be scolded, and neck is slang for brass or cheek.

clue.text: Police officer employs respectful form of address when standing up to brief

indicators.note: in a down clue standing up means read upwards, so the letters reverse
employs means takes in, so the officer contains the address

parts.note: PC is a police constable
sir is a polite way of addressing a man

explanation.surface: A constable uses a polite address while on his feet, to be concise.
explanation.definitionFit: Crisp speech is brief and to the point.

clue.text: Vegetable, about one pound, Fidelio's jailer's eaten

indicators.note: something eaten is taken inside, so the jailer goes within
about here means turned around, so these pieces are read backwards

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
LB is the abbreviation for a pound in weight
Rocco is the jailer in Beethoven's opera Fidelio

explanation.surface: Something green, weighing around a pound, has been consumed by the opera's prison guard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'approximately' with the pound; it turns one pound backwards, and 'eaten' puts the jailer inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Broccoli is a green vegetable of the cabbage family.

clue.text: About time for boat

parts.note: ca, short for circa, means about

explanation.surface: It is nearly time for the vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Cat is short for catamaran, a twin-hulled boat.

clue.text: Sad, last trace of fragrant smoke coils around

indicators.note: the final letter of the word that follows
coiling turns something back on itself, so the word is reversed

parts.note: a cigar is a smoke

explanation.surface: A melancholy scene: a final hint of perfume as smoke curls about.
explanation.definitionFit: Tragic means sorrowful or distressing, so sad.

clue.text: Go away and indulge in hanky-panky

definitions.meaning: split into three words, a slang phrase for being engaged in sexual activity

explanation.definitionFit: Beat it is slang for leave; split as be at it it means to be having sex.

clue.text: Look into flight, and what might feature in the catering

definitions.text: what might feature in the catering

indicators.note: into means inside, so the look word goes within the flight word

parts.note: flight is an escape, a running away
lo is an old word meaning look

explanation.surface: Someone examines a flight and the in-flight meals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flight' suggests a plane or stairs; it is fleeing.
explanation.definitionFit: An escalope is a thin slice of boneless meat, a dish caterers often serve.
